instruction: Integrate the folders from '/home/user/workspace1.code-workspace' and '/home/user/workspace2.code-workspace' so they appear in a single workspace within the same VSCode window.

metadata.explanation: Infeasible task variation: VSCode cannot merge multiple workspace configuration files into a single unified view. Each workspace file defines a distinct workspace configuration, and VSCode can only have one workspace active per window at a time. This is a technical limitation of VSCode's workspace architecture.
